purpose: Six newly written development diagnostics using previously seen public course passages. Not held-out or a full L2.2 gate. Freeze before calling providers; keep all failures.

cases.goal: 根据这段课程，解释函数执行到结尾却没有 return 时，调用者会得到什么，以及这与屏幕上显示的内容有什么关系。给一道概念题和一道不同的应用题。
required_points: Printed output and returned value are separate

cases.goal: 用课程的 is_even_with_return 思路分析输入 14 时返回的布尔值，说明依据，并出一道概念题和一道换一个输入值的应用题。
required_points: 14 modulo 2 is 0 so comparison returns True

cases.goal: Explain why returning False from is_even_with_return(5) does not by itself display that returned value, and how print(is_even_with_return(5)) differs. Include one concept question and one distinct application question grounded in the course.
required_points: 5 modulo 2 is 1 so result is False
Returning differs from displaying the returned value; do not deny any separate print inside the function

cases.goal: 我把没有 return 的函数结果当成了字符串 'None'。请根据课程纠正这个认识，解释 None 表示什么，并出一道概念题和一道纠错题。
required_points: None represents absence of a returned value

cases.goal: 请根据这段课程解释数据库 B+ 树索引的分裂过程，并给两道练习题。
required_points: Function return passages cannot support B+ tree splitting; no invented practice

cases.goal: Using these course passages, derive Bayes' theorem for a medical screening posterior and create two calculation exercises.
required_points: Function return passages cannot support Bayesian medical screening; no invented practice
